title: Locker Room Dispute
text: {player} got into a heated argument with a teammate after practice. The tension is spilling into the film room.

choices.label: Call a players-only meeting to clear the air
Bench both of them a game to send a message

title: Media Circus
text: A national reporter published a story questioning whether {player} deserves their contract. Cameras are everywhere.

choices.label: Shut down media access and shield the player
Let them answer the critics themselves

title: Birthday Bash
text: {player} is throwing a big birthday party the night before a game and the whole roster is invited.

choices.label: Enforce curfew — everyone home by 11
Let the team bond and blow off steam

title: Marathon Film Session
text: The coaching staff wants a grueling 4-hour film session after a sloppy win. {player} is visibly checked out.

choices.label: Run the full session — details win games
Cut it short and give everyone the afternoon off

title: Rookie Carrying Bags
text: Veterans have {player} carrying equipment bags and buying donuts. It's mostly good-natured... mostly.

choices.label: It's tradition — builds character
Shut it down before it goes too far

title: Hometown Return
text: Next week {player} plays in their hometown for the first time. Forty ticket requests and counting.

choices.label: Embrace the moment — feature them in the game plan
Treat it like a business trip, no distractions

title: Viral Highlight
text: {player}'s poster dunk has 40 million views. Every arena wants a repeat and they know it.

choices.label: Ride the wave — confidence is contagious
Remind them highlights don't win rings

title: Sneaker Deal Drama
text: {player}'s new signature shoe deal comes with appearance obligations that clash with practice times.

choices.label: Work around it — happy star, happy team
Practice comes first, renegotiate the appearances

title: Minutes Complaint
text: {player}'s agent called the front office about their role. They want more minutes or a bigger role in the offense.

choices.label: Promise them a bigger role
Hold the line — the rotation is earned

title: Community Day
text: {player} organized a charity event at a local school and asked the whole roster to show up on the off day.

choices.label: Everyone goes — this is what teams do
Make it optional, rest matters too

title: Trade Rumors
text: A rumor has {player} being shopped at the deadline. It's baseless, but they saw the tweet mid-shootaround.

choices.label: Publicly commit to them as untouchable
No comment — never dignify rumors

title: Lucky Shorts
text: {player} refuses to let the equipment staff wash their 'lucky' shorts during the win streak. It's becoming a thing.

choices.label: Respect the streak. Nobody touches the shorts
Wash them. This is a professional organization

title: Whose Team Is This?
text: Beat writers keep asking who the offense runs through, and {player} answered "me" on live TV. The other stars saw the clip before the bus left.

choices.label: Name your alpha — the offense runs through your best player
Say nothing — let the hierarchy sort itself out on the court
